sections.title: Sign-in and sign-up database calls
sections.what: Looks up a user by email to get their stored password hash and name, and saves a new user row.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps database access out of the sign-in logic.
sections.watch_out: The lookup returns the password hash, so callers must not pass it on.

summary: Finds users by email for sign-in and saves new users.
purpose: Database access for sign-in and registration.
why: Likely reason: keeps database access out of the sign-in rules.
how: 1. Find a user by email, returning the ID, name, email and stored password hash. 2. Create a user from the supplied fields.
inputs: An email for lookup. For creation, a name, email, password hash, and the time the age was confirmed.
outputs: A user record, or the new user's ID.
risks: The lookup returns the stored password hash, so it must never reach the browser.
debug: If sign-in never finds a user, check that the email is lowercased before lookup.
